items.title: Kyle Monangai: Dealing with soft-tissue injury
items.body_text: Coach Ben Johnson noted Monday that Monangai is dealing with a soft-tissue injury, Brad Biggs of the Chicago Tribune reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Chris Rodriguez: Progressing in recovery
items.body_text: Rodriguez (foot) participated in team drills during Sunday's training camp practice, John Shipley of SI.com reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Deebo Samuel: Goes through full practice Saturday
items.body_text: Samuel was a full participant in Saturday's training camp practice, his first since signing with the 49ers on Thursday, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Xavier Worthy: Avoids serious injury
items.body_text: Worthy is believed to avoided a serious shoulder injury that he sustained during the final session of Saturday's training camp practice, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Cyrus Allen: Diagnosed with shin bruise
items.body_text: Allen was diagnosed with a shin bruise on his left leg that he suffered during Saturday's training camp practice, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
